atoms.a: The local primary school is putting on a play in 3 weeks. How long until the big day?
It takes Andrea 8 minutes to run a kilometre. How long is that in seconds?
Last night Dennis slept for 420 minutes. How many hours of sleep did he get?
Marcus has counted that there are only 35 days left until his birthday. How many weeks is that?
My dog is 3 years old. How old is he in months?
The twins have been playing this game for 600 seconds. How many minutes is that?
Our biology exam lasted 2 hours. How many minutes long was the exam?
Sherifah is going on holiday in 240 hours. How many days is that?
